sentences.en: There were food and drink in abundance at the party.
sentences.zh: 派对上食物和饮料非常丰富。

sentences.en: Rice is cultivated in regions with an abundance of rain.
sentences.zh: 在雨量充沛的地区种植水稻。

sentences.en: Hunger often produces immortal poems. Abundance, only indigestion and clumsiness.
sentences.zh: 饥饿常常催生不朽的诗篇。而丰裕则只会带来消化不良和笨拙。

senses.zh: 丰富，充裕,大量，极多,盈余,丰度
